july_ultimatum_1914.title: The July Crisis
july_ultimatum_1914.description: Ultimatums have expired across the continent and mobilisation telegrams race down every telegraph line.

options.title: Sound general mobilisation
options.consequence: Rally public resolve and call up reserves.

options.title: Prioritise domestic order
options.consequence: Keep railways focused on civil supply and stability.

christmas_truce_1914.title: Winter Lull on the Front
christmas_truce_1914.description: Frost settles over the forward trenches as exhausted regiments pause under a quiet winter sky.

options.title: Allow a brief winter respite
options.consequence: Restore home-front calm at a slight dip in fervour.

options.title: Enforce strict front discipline
options.consequence: Maintain combat tempo through the winter freeze.
